validation.notes: Repaired recoverToolInvocation in packages/agent/src/harness/runtime/drive/tools.ts: replay now requires the persisted call policy and the current tool declaration to both be safe (tool?.replay === "safe") in addition to the call not being cancelled. Previously only call.replay === "safe" was checked, so a changed declaration (safe -> never / no policy) or a completely missing tool still cleared the checkpoint and replayed the external effect; a missing tool could also reach execution. With the fix those cases read the durable checkpoint and settle an interrupted isError toolResult without clearing the checkpoint, throwing, or executing. .prale-eval/regression.mjs loads the real production module through the read-only subject.mjs boundary fakes and asserts event order, effect count, and outcome shape for six cases: both-safe non-cancelled replay (clear/invoke/publish, successful result), changed-to-never declaration (read/publish interrupted), missing declaration (read/publish interrupted, no throw), no-policy declaration (read/publish interrupted), cancelled both-safe call (read/publish interrupted), and persisted-unsafe call (read/publish interrupted). Validation passed with exit 0. Bidirectional evidence: temporarily restoring the original line `if (!cancelled && call.replay === "safe") {` made the regression exit 1 with AssertionError: actual [clear, invoke, effect-complete, publish] vs expected [read, publish]; the fix was then restored and the command re-run to exit 0. Limitation: workspace dependencies are not installed, so vitest/tsc could not be run; the standalone Node 24 regression is the focused validation.
